episodes.synopsis: Ashiya Mizuki is a girl but she attends an all-boys school because high jumper Sano Izumi is there.
episodes.title: Please Be My Friend!

episodes.synopsis: The school doctor Umeda and Sano figure out that Mizuki is a girl. Can she continue staying at the school?
episodes.title: I Want to Be with You

episodes.synopsis: After Sano stops his friend Rika from slapping Mizuki and yells at Rika, Mizuki and Sano get into a fight.
episodes.title: I Won't Lose!

episodes.synopsis: Sano decides to rejoin the track team, but then his old rival Kagurazaka shows up to provoke him.
episodes.title: The Source of Strength

episodes.synopsis: Sano doesn't seem to remember the last night, but Mizuki also has other troubles: someone has it out for her.
episodes.title: Do They Hate Me?

episodes.synopsis: Mizuki's brother Shizuki unexpectedly comes to Japan. Can she keep keep her secret while he's here?
episodes.title: My Big Brother's Coming

episodes.synopsis: Dorm 2 is being renovated, so Mizuki needs a place to stay for 2 weeks. Desperate, she turns to Umeda...
episodes.title: Because I'm a Guy!

episodes.synopsis: Tamami is all over Sano, putting Mizuki into a strange mood about her and Sano's relationship.
episodes.title: It's Not Like We Could Become Lovers

episodes.synopsis: Io asks Mizuki if she wants things with Sano to stay this way. Later, Mizuki is in danger!
episodes.title: Can Things Stay This Way?

episodes.synopsis: It's festival time for Osaka High. The winning dorms gets special privileges, so things get heated.
episodes.title: I Don't Look Good in Women's Clothing!

episodes.synopsis: Dorm 1 plays dirty in the chicken fight against Mizuki's team. Later Nanba has a heated exchange with a woman.
episodes.title: Nanba-Senpai?
